crop.notes: Article is complete; the lower part of the clipping is an unrelated Mermod & Jaccard advertisement and the next headline.

ocr.notes: Minor errors ('slugring', 'vetting', 'Poolalley', 'cauowed'); also includes the following advertisement text.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Lem McGregor, "the St. Joe Kid," knocked Tom Allen down in a quarrel at Allen's saloon, and was himself beaten later that day by Billy Zachritz in Pool alley.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Saturday Morning, July 26, 1890, page 8.

facts.fact: Lem McGregor, "the St. Joe Kid," got into a quarrel with Allen in Allen's saloon, knocked him down and punished him considerably

notes: Zachritz-McGregor street fight is not about Allen, so it is left out of the facts.
